Senses.Explanation: “wherever” or “in every place.” Throughout the sampled corpus, its Chan value lies chiefly in the predicates whose scope it sets. Linji's record has the fixed line “act as host wherever you are; every place you stand is genuine” (隨處作主，立處皆真). Yuanwu preserves the paired formula “act as host wherever you are; on meeting conditions, they are the source” (隨處作主，遇緣即宗). A teaching-seat address defines the work of a lineage teacher with “wherever he is, he raises the guiding principle; he answers questions according to the occasion” (隨處提綱，應機問答). Other records use the same distributive word in “named wherever [it appears]” (隨處立名), “arise right here and perish wherever” (當處出生，隨處滅盡), and “clear wherever [you are]” (隨處明了). These predicates are distinct; the location word is not. No departure from its ordinary distributive meaning was found, and none is manufactured.
